title: Elucidation of the inhibitory effect of (+)-hopeaphenol on polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid-induced innate immunity activation in human cerebral microvascular endothelial cells.
authors: Xu, Liu; Yu, Zaiqiang; Uekusa, Yoshinori; Kawaguchi, Shogo; Kikuchi, Haruhisa; Daitoku, Kazuyuki; Minakawa, Masahito; Motomura, Shigeru; Furukawa, Ken-Ichi; Oshima, Yoshiteru; Seya, Kazuhiko; Imaizumi, Tadaatsu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇四聚体抑制poly IC诱导的先天免疫激活，涉及NF-kB转录因子磷酸化及分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Drug development for regulating the innate immune system is important for the prevention and treatment of autoinflammatory and autoimmune diseases. In this context, we investigated the effect of resveratrol derivatives on the inflammatory reactions in the brain. Resveratrol, which can be found in Vitis plants in the form of oligomers, exhibits neuroprotective effects; however, its regulatory effects on innate immunity are still unclear. We examined the effects of (+)-hopeaphenol, a resveratrol tetramer, and its derivatives on the polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid (poly IC)-induced production of interferon (IFN)-beta and C-X-C motif chemokine 10 (CXCL10) in the cultured human cerebral microvascular endothelial cell line hCMEC/D3. (+)-Hopeaphenol (1-10 muM) inhibited the poly IC-induced production of not only CXCL10 but also retinoic acid-inducible gene-I in a dose-dependent manner and significantly reduced the poly IC-induced IFN-beta gene expression and protein release from hCMEC/D3 cells by inhibiting the phosphorylation of p65 but not that of the interferon regulatory transcription factor IRF3. A docking study indicated a high affinity of (+)-hopeaphenol for p65. These results suggest that (+)-hopeaphenol can regulate the innate immune system by inhibiting the poly IC/IFN-beta/CXCL10 signaling axis via suppression of the phosphorylation of the transcription factor NF-kB.
abstract_zh: 调节先天免疫系统的药物开发对于自身炎症性疾病和自身免疫性疾病的预防与治疗具有重要意义。在此背景下，我们研究了白藜芦醇衍生物对脑部炎症反应的影响。白藜芦醇以寡聚体形式存在于葡萄属植物中，具有神经保护作用；然而，其对先天免疫的调节作用仍不清楚。我们考察了白藜芦醇四聚体(+)-hopeaphenol及其衍生物对聚肌胞苷酸 (poly IC) 诱导的人脑微血管内皮细胞系hCMEC/D3中干扰素 (IFN)-β和C-X-C基序趋化因子10 (CXCL10) 产生的影响。(+)-Hopeaphenol (1-10 μM) 以剂量依赖性方式抑制了poly IC诱导的CXCL10及维甲酸诱导基因-I的产生，并通过抑制p65的磷酸化（而非干扰素调节转录因子IRF3的磷酸化）显著降低了poly IC诱导的hCMEC/D3细胞中IFN-β基因表达和蛋白释放。对接研究表明(+)-hopeaphenol对p65具有高亲和力。这些结果表明，(+)-hopeaphenol可通过抑制转录因子NF-kB的磷酸化来调节先天免疫系统，从而抑制poly IC/IFN-β/CXCL10信号轴。
